## Summary

Describe what changed and why.

## Scope & boundaries

- [ ] Change is contained to the smallest appropriate scope (module → cluster → project).
- [ ] Any required escalations are documented.

## Meaning-first parity (drift)

- [ ] Meaning artifacts updated for any behavior/intent/interface changes.
- [ ] No contradictions between docs/templates/examples and implementation.
- [ ] Drift risks (if any) are noted and mitigated.

## Tool-agnostic purity

- [ ] No tool/vendor-specific requirements leaked into the normative core docs (`docs/`).
- [ ] Any tool-specific guidance is isolated under `adapters/` and labeled **NON-NORMATIVE**.

## Validation

- [ ] Relevant checks/tests run (or explicitly marked N/A).
- [ ] Links and cross-references updated (or explicitly marked N/A).
